a.sound: A town is smaller than a city. There are shops and places to go, but it’s not very crowded.
A village is smaller than a town. There are not many houses or shops. It’s not very busy.
A city is very big. There are lots of people and tall buildings. It’s busy and loud.

instruction.text: Where does this person live? Listen and choose.

atoms.a: I live in a large place that’s always loud and busy, with tall buildings and crowds everywhere.
I live in a smaller place, but there are shops, restaurants and houses all close together.
I live far outside the city in a quiet place with a few houses and small gardens.

atoms.b: My name is Aisha and I live in a ((++village city)). It’s quiet and there are only a few houses. I like it because it’s not too busy. Where do you live, Peter?
atoms.sound: My name is Eyeesha and I live in a village. It’s quiet and there are only a few houses. I like it because it’s not too busy. Where do you live, Peter?

atoms.b: I live in a ((++city town)). It’s very big and there are lots of people. It’s noisy, but I like it because there is always something to do. What about you, Mohammed?
I live in a ((++town city)). It’s smaller than a city, but you can still do many things there. It’s not too crowded, and people are friendly.

atoms.a: Why does Aisha like living in a village?
atoms.sound: Why does Eyeesha like living in a village?
b: ++She likes that it’s not too busy.
She likes that many people know each other.
She likes that it’s very big.

atoms.a: Which place is the most crowded?
b: A village is the most crowded.
A town is the most crowded.

atoms.a: What does Peter like about the city?
b: ++He likes that there’s always something to do.
He likes that it’s not too busy.

atoms.a: Which place is not very big, but there are still many things you can do there?
b: ++A town is not very big but has many things to do.
A village is not very big but has many things to do.
A city is not very big but has many things to do.
